summary: Bragg Gaming Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, containing its Notice of Annual General Meeting and Management Information Circular for a meeting scheduled June 18, 2026, in Toronto. The agenda includes receiving audited financial statements, electing directors, and reappointing auditors. This is a routine annual meeting notice, not a special-situation event. No material terms, premiums, or strategic actions are disclosed.
